title: The grid settings are somewhere you would actually look
goal: The grid can be switched on and off from the View menu, but everything that shapes it, the spacing, whether it draws columns or both, how often a line is bold, where it starts and how fine it may get, is buried in a panel section that only appears after you click the Canvas row in the layers list. Nobody finds that. The settings should be reachable from where the grid is switched on, and from the grid itself.
notes: Reported by the user on 2026-09-05: I still do not have any way to configure the grid as far as I know. They are right in practice. What exists today, from a read: EditorCommands.swift line 525 puts Show Grid on Command apostrophe and a Snap to Grid toggle on the View menu, and that is all the menu offers. Every number lives in LayersPanel.gridSection (line 3122), which is drawn inside the Canvas inspector section, and that section only renders its content when editorState.isCanvasSelected (line 452). So the settings require knowing to click the Canvas row in the layers list first. The comment above gridSection explains the reasoning, that the grid belongs to the canvas, which is sound as a model but is not how anyone will look for it. Options for the runner to weigh and record: add the settings under the View menu item itself, put them in a small popover hung off the menu or off a grid button, or surface the Canvas section automatically when the grid is switched on. Do not simply move them and leave the Canvas section empty. This pairs with the pending task you-can-say-where-the-grid-starts-and-how-fine-i, which adds the origin and smallest cell; whichever lands second must put its new settings in the same place as the first.
acceptance: Reaching every grid setting takes one obvious step from the View menu or from wherever the grid is turned on, with no prior selection needed
The settings are still there for someone who arrives by clicking the Canvas row, so nothing that works today stops working
Switching the grid on for the first time makes it clear where its settings are, without a tour or a tip that has to be dismissed
The settings say what each number does in plain words, including what the smallest cell means
A person who has never used the app can turn on the grid, set it to eight points and make every fourth line bold, without being told where to go
Audit written under queue/audits/ showing the path from switching it on to changing a number, anything rough filed as a follow-up

log.note: Adversarial review before building. Walked it as a first timer: you press Command apostrophe, graph paper appears, and nothing on screen has changed except the picture. The only route to a number is to know that the Canvas row at the bottom of the layers list is a thing you can click. Rejected putting the numbers ON the View menu: spacing and bold-every are typed values and a menu cannot hold a text field you watch the canvas answer. Rejected auto-selecting the Canvas row, which throws away the layer you had picked (the sibling task turning-the-grid-on-says-where-its-numbers-are says the same). Rejected a first-run tip, because acceptance forbids something to dismiss. Chose: the grid gets a small chip in the floating bar beside zoom, present only while the grid is showing, reading the live spacing, opening every setting in a popover; plus View menu gains Grid Settings, right under Show Grid, opening the same popover and switching the grid on first if it was off. The chip appearing at the same instant the lines appear IS the discovery cue, and the menu you turned it on from now lists its settings next to the switch. The Canvas section keeps the identical controls by sharing one view, so nothing that works today stops working. Shortest version that delivers the value: one shared control view, one chip, one menu row.

Toolbar width is the scarce resource here (EditorChromeLayout comments: a measurements pill was removed from this bar for exactly this reason). Mitigation: the chip only exists while the grid is on, and below a canvas width threshold it drops its spacing readout and shows the glyph alone.

Built. One shared control view (Sources/Photonz/CanvasGridSettingsView.swift) now draws every grid setting, and three places show it: the new chip in the floating tool bar (EditorView.gridChip, beside the zoom, only while the grid is showing and only on a canvas at least 620pt wide), View menu Grid Settings (EditorCommands, right under Show Grid, calls EditorState.showGridSettings which switches the grid on first when it was off), and the Canvas section of the panel, which now draws the same view instead of its own copy. Copy lives in PhotonzCore CanvasGridCopy so both places say the same words and a test can hold them to a standard.

Post-build review on the real app, through Scripts/playtest/grid-settings-walk.json against the probe with Screen Recording granted, so every picture is a real capture. Two things were clumsy and got fixed before calling it ready: the popover was titled Grid over a checkbox also called Grid (the checkbox is now Show grid, matching the menu and reading in parallel with Snap to grid, and the five existing grid walks were updated), and the Columns / Columns and rows picker had no label at all, so a first timer saw two phrases floating between two checkboxes (it now has the word Lines above it and its explanation below).

Verified against acceptance: (1) chip is one press from the lines, Grid Settings is one row under Show Grid, neither needs a selection: the walk does the whole thing with a Rectangle selected; (2) the Canvas row still shows the identical controls, screenshotted at step 10; (3) the chip appears at the instant the lines do, no tip to dismiss; (4) every number carries one plain line, including what the smallest cell means; (5) walk types 8 into Spacing and 4 into Bold every from the popover with the layers list never touched; (6) audit at queue/audits/2026-09-05-grid-settings.json with three real captures.

Harness: focus and type steps now look at the editor window AND any popover attached to it, otherwise no walk could ever type into a number that lives in a popover. New playtest actions toggleGrid and showGridSettings, because the probe's menu bar refuses window scoped chords while unfocused. Scripts/test.sh green (3367 tests), and all five existing grid walks re-run green after the Show grid rename.

Grid settings reachable in one step from the grid itself and from the View menu: a chip in the tool bar beside the zoom while the grid is showing, and View > Grid Settings under Show Grid, both opening the same controls the Canvas section draws. Verified on the probe with Scripts/playtest/grid-settings-walk.json and real screen captures; Scripts/test.sh green (3367); audit at queue/audits/2026-09-05-grid-settings.json.
